discover_bundles takes the resolved search path as a parameter and _BUNDLE_ENV_VAR moves to settings.py; resolve_description_store_root is renamed resolve_store_root with an optional form and a refusal naming the kind of root, every caller moving with it; imas_ambix/data/bundle.py declares eddb_cache from paths.JT60SA_ROOT; pulse_writer.py gains public pulse_path(out_root, pulse, run) returning out_root/PULSE_RUN.nc such as 101154_0.nc, used by write_pulse, which writes one imas.DBEntry netCDF per pulse and run holding every description IDS of the shot's phase with the served signals, refusing an existing file without --overwrite through PulseWriteError, and its hard-coded JT60SA_ROOT cache lookup retires; scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py _read_pulse_ids reads through pulse_path; imas-alambic write takes positional pulses with --run, --machine, --maps, --out, --cache and --overwrite, and imas-alambic config prints each resolved setting with its source; in a clean uv venv --python 3.12 with only the imas-alambic and nova-cocos wheels, a synthetic IMAS_ALAMBIC_HOME holding one synthetic flat bundle makes config report derived paths and the inferred machine and write produce ids/PULSE_0.nc holding every description IDS of its phase; here, with packages/imas-alambic/src on PYTHONPATH, imas-alambic write 101154 --machine jt-60sa --out a scratch directory writes 101154_0.nc whose IDS set equals the phase description store's and whose IDSs equal the per-IDS writer's output at base 9b440888 by imas-python comparison; git grep finds IMAS_ALAMBIC_ variables read only in settings.py and no literal-key store-root lookup in packages/imas-alambic/src; tests/data/test_pulse_writer.py and packages/imas-alambic/tests add no failures against the base;
